toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: Return every Agent Papers category with counts and short descriptions so an agent can choose the right comparison surface.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search Agent Papers companies by name or tagline, optionally constrained by category and status. Returns compact vendor records for ranking.

toolsPreview.name: get_company
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one full Agent Papers company entry including offerings, sources, freshness, and category-specific facts.

toolsPreview.name: compare
toolsPreview.description: Return a comparison matrix for one category with common fields and buyer-relevant category fields.

toolsPreview.name: get_schema
toolsPreview.description: Return field names and plain-English buyer reasons for the full registry schema or one category.

toolsPreview.name: whats_new
toolsPreview.description: Return changelog entries derived from registry added and updated dates, optionally filtered from a YYYY-MM-DD date.
